items.zh: 有时山穷水尽，但总会柳暗花明。
items.en: Sometimes dark clouds have silver linings.

items.zh: 没有什么比做好防晒更重要了。
items.en: Nothing beats protecting yourself against the sun.

items.zh: 文化和新闻界依旧生机勃勃，未来可期。
items.en: Its culture and press, remain vibrant and unpredictable.

items.zh: 坚持每天锻炼不仅能增强体质，还能缓解压力。
items.en: Regular exercise can not only build up physical strength, but also relieve mental stress.

items.zh: 新课程告诉我们：学习过程中及时有效的自我评价不仅能够保证学习的速度和质量，更能保证学习方向的正确性。
items.en: The new curriculum teaches us that timely and effective self-evaluation can not only ensure the pace and quality of study, but also keep learning on the right track.
